_readme: Planned items that are NOT in the game yet, with the prices worked out on 2026-09-20 (see docs/FUTURE_PRICES.md for the reasoning). The game does not read this file. To add one, copy its entries into economy.json (a projectile needs a `shop.items` entry AND a `projectiles.<id>` entry, a buff only a `shop.items` entry), add its picture, and check 'py tools/economy_report.py'. Names, images and descriptions are placeholders. Basis: 75% hit rate, one use of a buff = one stack of its own tier, buff price = 60% of the return, +-25% ranges, hit value = 1.6 x the average price per piece. (The common 1.1x coin bonus was added to the game as Snowy Cube on 2026-09-20, so it is no longer listed here.) The rare 20% save was added as Mints on 2026-09-20. The legendary Sure Shot (a guaranteed hit) was built as the Diamond Cross on 2026-09-20. The legendary 1.5x coin bonus was added as Daniel's 3 PLN on 2026-09-20. The epic standard projectile was added as the Tomato on 2026-09-20. The epic 50% save was added as the epic Mints (id mints_epic) on 2026-09-20. The legendary disco summon buff was built as the Disco Ticket (id disco_ticket) on 2026-09-20 (branch disco-event, not pushed). The legendary heavy hitter was added as the Drone (id drone) on 2026-09-21 (branch drone, not pushed). The epic Triangles (30% slower) were added as the Chilli Triangles (id triangles_chilli) on 2026-09-21. The epic 1.35x coin bonus was added as the Burger (id burger) on 2026-09-21 (branch night-blizzard, not pushed).

projectiles._note: LEGENDARY STANDARD. Average stack 15000, hit value 4800 (the legendary rarity default).

buffs._note: LEGENDARY FREE THROW (replaces the legendary 50% save): a one-time charge, no timer - the NEXT throw that would use up a bought projectile does not (never spent on the snowball; the save-chance roll comes first and the charge is only spent if that fails; several charges queue one per throw). NEEDS A NEW MECHANIC (effect 'freeThrow'). Worth one piece of the best projectile (3,000 standard, 7,500 heavy hitter): priced at one standard piece.
buffs.name: TBD

buffs._note: LEGENDARY TRIANGLES: the offset slider at 0.5x speed (50% slower); the ladder is common 0.9, rare 0.8, epic 0.7 (Chilli Triangles), legendary 0.5. Price: +25 points of hit rate = 0.25 x 1.6 x 15,000 = 6,000 return, 60% = 3,600, +-25%.
buffs.name: TBD
buffs.description: Tasty shapes to make your hand steadier.

price_ladder_summary.face_multiplier: x2.5 fits a legendary standard projectile; with a lower-tier projectile it pays little (a buff for the best projectile). If it should depend on the projectile: 2.5 x the buff's price / the hit value, kept between x2 and x20.
price_ladder_summary.save_chance_ladder: 10% common (Water Bottle), 20% rare (Mints), 50% epic (planned); they stack as independent rolls, 64% together, capped at 90%. Legendary = a one-time free throw instead of a percentage.
price_ladder_summary.stacking: Save chances: independent rolls, cap 90%. Coin multipliers and offset slow-downs multiply, no cap.
